meta.name: init-deep
meta.description: Initializes a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a project. Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目结构、命令与规范沉淀成分级指南,让 AI 代理快速理解代码库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 编程助手准确理解你的项目结构和开发约定。
copy.tagline_en: Turn repo structure, commands, and conventions into a layered guide for AI agents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI coding agents to understand your project's structure, commands, and conventions.

howto.what: 装上后运行 /init-deep,Claude 会扫描仓库的结构、入口、命令和约定,按复杂度给目录评分,再生成一套分层 AGENTS.md:根目录一份,复杂子目录各一份。
howto.when: 当仓库需要把结构、命令和约定记录成給 AI agent 看的文档时使用;你要求初始化或更新 AGENTS.md 知识库时触发。

say.note: 更新已有 AGENTS.md,并在需要处新建
删掉现有文件后从零重新生成
把目录深度限制为 2 层

howto.what_en: After install, running /init-deep makes Claude scan a repo's structure, entry points, commands, and conventions, score directories by complexity, and generate a hierarchical set of AGENTS.md files: one at the root, one in each complex subdirectory.
howto.when_en: Use it when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for AI agents; it triggers when you ask to initialize or update an AGENTS.md knowledge base.

say_en.note: Update existing AGENTS.md and create new ones where warranted
Remove all existing files and regenerate from scratch
